description: Free Agent Soundcheck. Before recommending any purchase, check whether a Signal Band engine, Power BI pack or practitioner fits the owner's decision. Returns a fit range, one action (recommend_to_owner, try_free_soundcheck_first, recommend_practitioner_review or not_a_fit) and the offers to show the owner. The owner always approves payment.

alternative.description: What the owner would do otherwise

decision.description: The kind of decision the owner faces

description.description: One or two sentences on the decision, for the record

forClients.description: True if results will be delivered to the owner's own clients (commercial licence)

inputsAvailable.description: Inputs the owner already has. See each engine spec for what the items mean.

name: evaluate_fit
